image_description: A wooden staircase interior featuring a prominent bannister system. The handrail is dark polished wood with a curved transition at the landing. Balusters are vertical, slender wooden posts, evenly spaced, supporting the handrail. The stairs have yellow painted risers and wooden treads. A newel post anchors the corner of the landing. Background shows a white wall and a doorway.

The reflection in the small oval mirror and the perspective lines of the background door frame seem slightly inconsistent with the main camera angle, suggesting minor geometric warping common in AI interiors.
